title: May the force be with you: the role of hyper-mechanostability of the bone sialoprotein binding protein during early stages of Staphylococci infections
authors: Priscila S. F. C. Gomes; Meredith Forrester; Margaret Pace; Diego E. B. Gomes; Rafael C. Bernardi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金黄色葡萄球菌Bbp蛋白与纤维蛋白原α的机械稳定性，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，虽用MD模拟但对象与课题无关。
abstract: The bone sialoprotein-binding protein (Bbp) is a mechanoactive MSCRAMM protein expressed on the surface of Staphylococcus aureus that mediates adherence of the bacterium to fibrinogen- α (Fg α ), a component of the bone and dentine extracellular matrix of the host cell. Mechanoactive proteins like Bbp have key roles in several physiological and pathological processes. Particularly, the Bbp:Fg α interaction is important in the formation of biofilms, an important virulence factor of pathogenic bacteria. Here, we investigated the mechanostability of the Bbp:Fg α complex using in silico single-molecule force spectroscopy (SMFS), in an approach that combines results from all-atom and coarse-grained steered molecular dynamics (SMD) simulations. Our results show that Bbp is the most mechanostable MSCRAMM investigated thus far, reaching rupture forces beyond the 2 nN range in typical experimental SMFS pulling rates. Our results show that high force-loads, which are common during initial stages of bacterial infection, stabilize the interconnection between the protein’s amino acids, making the protein more “rigid”. Our results offer new insights that are crucial on the development of novel anti-adhesion strategies.
abstract_zh: 骨唾液蛋白结合蛋白（Bbp）是一种机械活性MSCRAMM蛋白，表达于金黄色葡萄球菌表面，介导细菌与宿主细胞骨及牙本质细胞外基质成分纤维蛋白原-α（Fg α）的黏附。像Bbp这样的机械活性蛋白在多种生理和病理过程中发挥关键作用。特别是，Bbp:Fg α相互作用在生物膜形成中至关重要，而生物膜是致病菌的重要毒力因子。在此，我们利用计算机模拟单分子力谱（SMFS）研究了Bbp:Fg α复合物的机械稳定性，该方法结合了全原子和粗粒化拉伸分子动力学（SMD）模拟的结果。我们的结果表明，Bbp是迄今研究过的MSCRAMM中机械稳定性最强的，在典型的实验SMFS拉伸速率下，其断裂力超过2 nN范围。我们的结果显示，在细菌感染初期常见的高力载荷下，蛋白质氨基酸之间的连接得以稳定，使蛋白质更加“刚性”。我们的结果为开发新型抗黏附策略提供了关键的新见解。
